name: 63068 · New Haven, MO
findings: ZIP 63068 (New Haven) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63068 (New Haven) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 63068 (New Haven) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
